headline: Regency Centers (REG) Stock Looks Cheap On Cash Flow But Fair On Earnings
summary: Regency Centers has delivered a 50.1% share price gain over the past five years, and current valuation checks now suggest the stock trades at a discount to its estimated intrinsic value using a Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) approach. Over five years, Regency Centers has returned 50.1%, which puts the recent share price around US$80 in the context of steady longer term gains rather than a short term spike.
